Line charts, one per world: horizontal, the rabbit's smell as evidence that it is a predator, in nats (sextile means); vertical, the share of chosen steps in percent; one line per run, marker shape for the agent type. Hydration heat maps, one per world and agent below the injury maps, with their own grey scale and colour bar: horizontal, nutrition one step earlier; vertical, hydration one step earlier (four bands: under 50, 50–100, 100–150, 150 and over); shade and number, the share of chosen steps in percent, except for time on the pond, where they show the share of steps off the pond one step earlier that arrive on it. ## f7_pond_traces__g10

Figure 7a — bush time before the first pond step, and pond visits, in each test scene across training; one chart per map size (10×10, then 15×15, then 20×20). **Axes.** Every small panel: horizontal, training progress in millions of training episodes at the saved checkpoint; vertical, a percentage from 0 to 100. Solid line: the share of each episode's steps before its first pond step that the agent spent on the bush, averaged over the {{W_EP_PER_CKPT}} episodes. Dotted line: the share of the {{W_EP_PER_CKPT}} episodes in which the agent reached the pond. Rows are the six animal setups; columns are the smell reach (whole map, 5 squares, 3 squares) and the injury at the start (0, 70). The agent type is the marker shape on each line (circle ordinary, triangle modulated), in neutral ink, since each panel is one world); a cross at the top marks a checkpoint where an episode ended by over-drinking.

| subset | used | available | share | why |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| checkpoints drawn, 10×10, smell across the map (2 runs × 12 scenes) | 1,200 | 1,200 | 100.0% | every saved checkpoint of each run and scene; no scene x checkpoint cell is dropped |
| checkpoints drawn, 10×10, smell 5 squares (2 runs × 12 scenes) | 1,200 | 1,200 | 100.0% | every saved checkpoint of each run and scene; no scene x checkpoint cell is dropped |
| checkpoints drawn, 10×10, smell 3 squares (2 runs × 12 scenes) | 1,200 | 1,200 | 100.0% | every saved checkpoint of each run and scene; no scene x checkpoint cell is dropped |
